textDesc: Mid-top lace-up outdoor-style shoes with a wrapped toe area and deep sole tread. The taller collar, upper eyelets and layered sides distinguish the construction from a low-cut sneaker. Mesh lining, EVA midsole and rubber outsole form the layers, with EU 39–48 assortment choices.
companyFaqDesc: Which color and EU size choices are listed?
Earth Yellow: EU 39–48; Khaki: EU 39–48; Black: EU 39–48.
A taller collar, conventional lace-up front, wrapped toe area and deep outsole tread. Mesh lining, EVA midsole and rubber outsole are specified for this model.
What should I assess on a sample?
Adjust the laces with the intended socks, then check toe room, instep fit and heel hold. For the mid-top style, also check the collar at the ankle.
What is the minimum order for the original style?
The listed original-style minimum is 2 pairs. Quantity pricing is shown on this page; logo and custom packaging proposals are quoted separately.
How can I request a sample?
Send the selected color, EU size and delivery postcode for a sample quotation covering the pair, courier charge and proposed dispatch date.
What should I send for logo or packaging requirements?
Send the logo artwork, preferred placement, packaging brief and order quantity. The proposal for this style will set out the applicable minimum, cost and sample process.
How can I get a delivered quotation?

Send pair quantities by color and EU size, the destination postcode or port and the packaging request. The quotation separates product cost and freight and includes the proposed dispatch and transit schedule.
